probe.tooltip.fps: Average Frames Per Second. Higher is better.
probe.tooltip.1pct: 1% Low FPS. Tracks frame drops and micro-stutters.
probe.tooltip.mspt: Milliseconds Per Tick. Must be under 50ms to maintain 20 TPS.
probe.tooltip.tps: Ticks Per Second. Server update rate. 20 is optimal.
probe.tooltip.memory: Peak RAM usage during the benchmark session.
probe.tooltip.gc_cycles: Garbage Collection cycles. High cycles mean heavy memory churn.
probe.tooltip.gc_time: Time the game froze to clean up memory (stutters).
probe.tooltip.entity_render: Time spent drawing entities on the screen.
probe.tooltip.gui_render: Time spent drawing the HUD and user interface.
probe.tooltip.alloc_rate: Memory Allocation Rate. How fast the game generates garbage (MB/s).
